Subject: Request: Dedicated GPU capacity architecture review for HelioTech POC

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the quick intro earlier this week. We are ramping a proof-of-concept that will run a mix of 7B and 13B models (some quantized), and we want a dedicated-capacity run-through with your team to validate pool sizing, autoscale behavior, and tenant isolation strategies before we commit to a Reserved plan.

High-level asks:
- 60–90 minute technical deep-dive with ops and infra (we'll bring our platform engineer)
- Focus on pool sizing (concurrency vs. slab sizes), autoscale thresholds, burst behavior, and failure isolation
- Discuss the canary/fallback plan and metrics to watch during rollout

Proposed windows (our timezone is PDT):
- Tue 5/26, 09:00–10:30 or 13:00–14:30
- Wed 5/27, 10:00–11:30

If those don't work, happy to propose alternatives. Also happy to share a short workload profile if useful.

Thanks,
Sam

Hi Sam — great to meet you (virtually). We'd be happy to run this. Marissa (solutions) and Aditya (runtime lead) are looped in so we can cover both sizing and the runtime tradeoffs.

Proposed agenda (60–75m):
1) 5m quick intros and scope
2) 20m workload profile & sizing rationale (you + Marissa questions)
3) 20m autoscale/fallback and canary plan (Aditya to cover)
4) 15m isolation, KV cache behavior, and failure scenarios
5) 10m actions + follow-ups & rollbar/metrics to monitor

Request before the call: could you fill out the attached workload-profile-template.xlsx with: model sizes, expected qps and burst concurrency, p50/p90/p99 targets, and a sample request token distribution? That will let us pre-run a sizing matrix.

Of the windows you proposed, Tue 5/26 13:00–14:30 PDT works best for us. If that slot is good on your end we'll send a calendar invite (we'll include a Drive folder and the initial pool-sizing-matrix).

Also: if you have any networking constraints (VPC peering, IP allowlist), put those in the sheet so we can include networking in the architecture section.

Attachments: workload-profile-template.xlsx

Best,
Mina
